title: Electrochemical Synthesis of a Tricyclo[5.4.0.01,5]undec-9-en-8,11-dione and Its Conversion to a Triqinane-type Compound
abstract: Abstract                9-Methoxy-6β-(3′,4′-dimethoxyphenyl)-2β,5α-dimethyltricyclo[5.4.0.01,5]undec-9-en-8,11-dione has been synthesized by using electrochemical oxidation of the corresponding phenol and then readily converted into a triquinane-type compound in 8 steps.
